units.source_text: 在我看来，它只不过是一首被煤烟熏黑了的奇妙的偶像，没有觉得有任何一点美。

en.t: To me, it was nothing more than a strange idol blackened by coal smoke, and I could not feel the slightest beauty in it.

units.source_text: 再上二层的潮音洞，看到据说出自狩野正信①手笔的仙女奏乐藻井图案。

en.t: Climbing farther up to the second-floor Choon Cave, I saw a coffered ceiling design of celestial maidens playing music, said to be by Kano Masanobu①.

units.source_text: 更上三层的究竟顶，即使看到各个角落残存的可怜的金箔痕迹，也无法觉得它的美。

en.t: Even higher, on the third-floor Kukkyoucho, I saw the pitiful traces of gold leaf remaining in every corner, yet I still could not feel its beauty.
